name: TransUnion (TLOxp)
instructions: Open https://service.transunion.com/dss/ccpa_optout.page and follow the site's steps for {full_name}. The site asks for a Social Security or driver's license number, which OpenOptOut never fills in; only finish it if you're comfortable sharing that with them. Use {contact_email} if it asks for an email address. Then press "I've done this".
notes: TLOxp is TransUnion's investigations database. The opt-out page asks for identifying numbers that OpenOptOut never fills in, so a person decides whether to finish it. This doesn't affect TransUnion credit reports.
source: TransUnion's California privacy opt-out page, listed in The Opt-Out Manual 2026 (public domain).
